items.obligation: E7. Retry and restart through the exact-byte executor journal. Each key (the legacy root key monthly:<net>:<vault>:<period>, the v2 root key monthly:v2:..., and each leaf key ...:<root>:leaf:<i>) holds one attempt. A pending attempt is only rebroadcast with the same bytes. A new send for a key needs a finalized revert of every same-nonce variant (retireRevertedAttempt), and the revert is retained under :reverted:<tx>. When another sender already admitted the root or committed the leaf, the executor keeps offering the journaled bytes until the signer's latest nonce passes them, and treats the step as settled only when the finalized nonce passes them. The legacy journal is reconciled before any v2 root send.

items.obligation: E9. D1 underfunding recovery. The coordinator creates obligations only when a vault snapshot no older than 30 minutes, with the same asset, covers this month's payable awards plus every earlier unreserved obligation in the vault, after subtracting other months' open pledges. Otherwise it creates nothing and returns 'underfunded', with one idempotent Inbox notice (notifyMonthlyUnderfunded keyed monthly-underfunded:<project>:<period>, ONCE). It retries every coordinator run and creates the obligations after a deposit. A missing snapshot, a stale snapshot or a different asset returns 'stale-funding'.
